claims.text: Machine-learning predictive modeling can determine melting temperatures across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can determine enthalpies and entropies of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can determine volume changes at melting across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can determine liquid-phase thermodynamic properties across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The proposed machine-learning approach is accurate and efficient.
The approach applies to solid and liquid phases of high-entropy alloys at high temperatures and across varying compositions and crystal structures.
High-entropy-alloy composition and crystal structure are the structural variables mediating the predictions.
Machine-learning algorithms learn patterns in training data and use those patterns to predict thermodynamic properties.
The proposed approach improves predictive accuracy relative to current methods for determining high-entropy-alloy thermodynamic properties.
The proposed approach improves efficiency relative to current methods for determining high-entropy-alloy thermodynamic properties.
Performance is limited by the quality and size of the training dataset.
Performance is limited by the complexity of the machine-learning model.
The complexity of high-entropy alloys and limitations of the machine-learning model introduce uncertainty into the predicted outcomes.
Predictions will be validated by comparison with experimental measurements on a set of high-entropy alloys.
Deviation of predicted thermodynamic properties from experimental measurements by more than 10% will falsify the hypothesis.
